_notice: Approved community memes shown on /meme-lab. Don't copy pictures here by hand: from the prototype folder run `python -m app.meme_gallery add <file> --name <name> --alt "what the meme shows and says" --credit "name or handle they gave"`. It removes hidden photo data (location, camera, notes) and adds the entry. CI (`python -m app.meme_gallery check`) fails if a picture here still has hidden data or isn't listed. Only post memes whose maker ticked all three boxes on the form.
